title.a: 1Password confirms security breach, says vaults were not affected

item.description: Password manager platform 1Password has confirmed that an attacker gained access to some of its backend systems and copied limited account information from a subset of customers. The company says customer vaults and their contents were not affected.
item.source: The Daily Star - Journalism without fear or favour

title.a: Switzerland, Canada, and Italy warn of AI-agent cyberattacks

item.description: Switzerland, Canada, and Italy have each warned that attackers are using AI agents to hack organisations faster than before, and have urged tighter defences.
item.source: The Daily Star - Journalism without fear or favour

title.a: EU targets technological sovereignty with $54 billion investment plan

item.description: The European Union (EU) has proposed a €50 billion ($54 billion) investment fund for quantum technology, artificial intelligence (AI) and other strategic industries as it seeks to strengthen its technological independence and compete with the United States and China.
item.source: The Daily Star - Journalism without fear or favour

title.a: QCY launches MeloBuds S1 noise-cancelling earbuds in Bangladesh

item.description: Chinese consumer electronics brand QCY has introduced new audio products in Bangladesh, including the MeloBuds S1 noise-cancelling earbuds and SP75 Bluetooth speaker, alongside the Watch GT4 smartwatch.
